run_openai_gpt_finetune: run the OpenAI GPT fine-tuning script with training and evaluation on a RocStories dataset
load_rocstories_dataset: load a RocStories CSV dataset and return a list of tuples containing story, continuations, and label
pre_process_datasets: pre-process encoded datasets into transformer input tensors with masked language modeling and multiple-choice labels
test_accuracy: test the accuracy function that computes prediction accuracy from logits and ground truth labels
summarize_main: summarize the main CLI entry point that parses arguments, loads model, trains, and evaluates an OpenAI GPT model
